phase_name: Create the Zotero item for Goldblatt 1989

objectives.description: Re-confirm absence via fresh export search and Web-API DOI search
objectives.note: zotero-search.sh Goldblatt -> only 4 known unrelated items (Topoi, 2x 2003/2006 survey, untitled). Live Web-API q=Goldblatt search -> same 4 items (keys JSFMAID3, QC846KVP, ICXDVDEJ, QCPAC6FB). Live Web-API DOI search for 10.1016/0168-0072(89)90032-8 -> [] (empty). Absence re-confirmed.

No storage/quota endpoint found (tried /users/2622830/storageadmin -> 404; no documented Web API quota endpoint exists). Per plan, treated the documented 2745.6 > 300 MB overage as authoritative -> DOI-only route chosen.

objectives.description: Choose create route (DOI-only default vs pdf attach) and dry-run
objectives.note: DOI-only route chosen (no headroom probe available). Dry-run via zotero-write.sh item-add --doi ... --dry-run previewed correctly (ok:true, would.source:doi).

objectives.description: Execute real create call, extract item key
objectives.note: Real call via zotero-write.sh item-add --doi 10.1016/0168-0072(89)90032-8 --idempotency-key task461-goldblatt1989-doi-add-1. .data.key = MJEB25VU. resolved metadata: title 'Varieties of complex algebras', author Goldblatt, journal Annals of Pure and Applied Logic, date 1989-10. stderr confirms 'NO PDF attached' honest surfacing.

objectives.description: Handle any attach failure / orphan cleanup
objectives.note: Not applicable -- no attach was attempted (DOI-only route). GET .../items/MJEB25VU/children returns [] -- no orphaned attachment records.

objectives.description: Verify via authenticated Web-API GET on item key
objectives.note: GET https://api.zotero.org/users/2622830/items/MJEB25VU returns itemType journalArticle, title 'Varieties of complex algebras', creator Robert Goldblatt, DOI 10.1016/0168-0072(89)90032-8, publicationTitle Annals of Pure and Applied Logic, date 1989-10, volume 44, pages 173-242. Matches research-verified bibliographic record exactly. Did NOT use zot read/search/zotero-search.sh for this verification (per plan's sync-lag caveat).

deviations.description: If an attach was attempted and failed (413 / .data.attachment_error present): enumerate GET .../items/<key>/children (read-only) and delete only the child attachment records with md5: null that this run created.
deviations.reason: No attach was attempted (DOI-only create route chosen since no quota headroom probe was available). GET .../items/MJEB25VU/children confirmed empty -- no orphan cleanup needed.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: skipped — not applicable; DOI-only create attempted no attachment, so there is no attach failure to handle. Confirmed GET .../items/MJEB25VU/children returns [].)*
